title: Phase 6 queue preview DTO boundary cleanup
summary: Migrates queue preview DTO imports from the desktop compatibility export to the existing core DTO inventory owner and removes the matching temporary boundary allowlist row.
reason: Phase 6 boundary cleanup is reducing remaining core-to-desktop imports in bounded DTO-only slices while leaving queue priority-marker and snapshot contract edges for separate queue-specific work.
behavior_before: Queue facade constructed QueuePreviewDto through mediapipeline.desktop.application.dto_inventory, producing two allowlisted NO_CORE_TO_DESKTOP findings in one import-statement group.
behavior_after: Queue facade constructs QueuePreviewDto from mediapipeline.core.kernel.dto_inventory while the desktop inventory DTO module remains a compatibility export; the queue facade DTO allowlist row is removed.
manual_validation: PASS: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe .\ops\scripts\dev\run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.check_dependency_boundaries --format json --report-only (hard_findings=56, allowlisted=56, unallowlisted=0, unused_allowlist=0, NO_CORE_TO_DESKTOP=39; domains: config=8, processes=9, publish=7, queue=6, schedule=1, status=8)
rollback_plan: Restore QueuePreviewDto imports in core queue facade to mediapipeline.desktop.application.dto_inventory, restore the removed allowlist row, refresh the generated queue facade summary, and mark AB-QUE-007 and AB-QUE-008 open again in the edge ledger.
notes:
DTO-only import ownership change. No Local API routes, WebView commands, queue selection/open behavior, priority markers, queue snapshot contracts, filesystem mutation, route schemas, or operator behavior changed.
Move QueuePreviewDto imports from desktop compatibility export to core DTO inventory.
Remove migrated temporary NO_CORE_TO_DESKTOP allowlist row for queue preview DTO imports.
Mark AB-QUE-007 and AB-QUE-008 migrated with core DTO ownership and removed allowlist action.
Refresh generated summary after queue facade DTO import ownership change.
